news_items.headline: Revolution Medicines announces NEJM publication of daraxonrasib Phase 1/2 data in pancreatic cancer
news_items.summary: NEJM published Phase 1/2 daraxonrasib data supporting rationale for the pivotal RASolute 302 Phase 3 trial in metastatic pancreatic cancer. Peer-reviewed validation of lead asset.

news_items.headline: FDA grants expanded access for daraxonrasib following positive RASolute 302 Phase 3 data; NDA submission planned
news_items.summary: FDA expanded access program for daraxonrasib granted on the back of Phase 3 RASolute 302 results; company guided to NDA submission. Regulatory progression catalyst.

news_items.headline: Wedbush, Piper Sandler, and Needham reiterate/initiate bullish on RVMD
news_items.summary: Three sell-side notes from Wedbush, Piper Sandler, and Needham issued same day in the wake of daraxonrasib Phase 3 data — contributed to the 20/0/0 buy/hold/sell consensus.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Wedbush, Piper Sandler, Needham all issued ratings on 2026-05-07 in wake of Phase 3 RASolute 302 data; sweep of PT hikes industry-wide post-ASCO Plenary. Consensus 20 buy / 0 hold / 0 sell with high $263 / low $140.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported 2026-05-06: $0 revenue (clinical-stage), non-GAAP EPS -$2.29 vs -$1.86 expected (miss on loss size). Street focus shifted from financials to daraxonrasib clinical/regulatory cadence — Phase 3 RASolute 302 readout already in hand, NDA submission and FDA expanded access are the live catalysts. Stock +52.9% over past month.
